releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.41 - Transparent Touch Lock & Zero-Blink Screen Experience
releaseNotes:
* Transparent Touch Lock: Eliminated all screen blinking, black overlay flickering, and alpha toggling. The screen remains 100% visible, crisp, and steady at all times
* Full Touch Protection: Screen touches are completely absorbed so accidental finger or pocket touches do nothing in Pocket FM or running ads
* Double-Tap Anywhere to Unlock: Double-tapping anywhere on the screen instantly unlocks touch input with double-haptic vibration feedback
* Seamless Background Dismissal: Automated ad skipping gestures execute through the transparent touch lock with zero visual flicker
* Sleek Top Status Pill: Compact glassmorphic pill briefly confirms touch lock activation and tap status without blocking content
